dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-contrast, thick white band across the greater coverts, sharply defined against dark gray-black feathers.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Prominent pale white-to-gray longitudinal edges along the folded primary and secondary feathers, creating a distinct striped boundary.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: High-contrast white rectangular patch centrally located on the posterior nape, bordered by black plumage.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp and distinct linear boundary separating the black crown from the yellowish-green mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible black ventral stripe extending down the center of the yellow breast; prominent white auricular patch.
